explain.narrative:
## Complexity, Ordering and Equality Contracts

Hash-based collections rely on consistent equals and hashCode; sorted collections rely on comparison. Big-O describes growth, not exact elapsed time.

Identify the input and desired result. Select the Java construct or API that supports the requirement. Keep code readable, handle documented failures and state assumptions clearly.

Compile with JDK 21, predict output before running, and test normal, boundary and invalid inputs.
